Aisha (Product Designer): Quick sync on the Private setup wizard network step. I prototyped a compact list row for each probe so the page doesn't feel like a terminal dump. Main idea: status chip + one-line hint + an explicit 'Show full probe output' chevron to reveal details.

Tom (Engineer): I like compactness. Two dev asks: 1) keep a prominent one-line failure summary so SREs know what to check at a glance; 2) when expanded, include a copy button for the raw logs and the exact command used to run the probe.

Kofi (Accessibility): Needs: chevron must be keyboard focusable, announce expanded/collapsed state (aria-expanded), and the probe completion should be announced via aria-live so screen reader users aren't left guessing. Also avoid color-only status.

Aisha (Product Designer): Plan: left-aligned pill with icon+text (Success / Action required), center hint (e.g., "Egress to model-hosts.redwood.ai blocked"), right-side chevron 'Show full probe output'. Move timestamp and raw command into expanded area.

Marcus (DevEx): Add a small 'Try these fixes' collapsible below failed rows with 2-3 actionable one-liners and a Retry button. KB links open in new tab and we capture clicks. Also prefer tooltips for cryptic hostnames.

Tom (Engineer): Implementation details: use a <pre> for logs, cap expansion height to 400px with internal scroll to avoid scroll hijack, include 'Copy log' and 'Copy command' buttons. Example command: `nc -vz model-hosts.redwood.ai 443`

Kofi (Accessibility): Ensure chip contrast passes AA. For status changes, use aria-live="polite" and provide descriptive text like 'Egress probe completed: action required'. The chevron should read 'Show full probe output including timestamp and command'.

Marta (PM): Metrics: we need probe duration, final status, whether user expanded details, and whether Retry was clicked. Also track KB click and tooltip open.

Aisha (Product Designer): I'll update figma and microcopy: compact rows, explicit chevron label, 'Try these fixes' shortbullets, and move raw technical bits into expanded details. Will add small helper text for network primitives.

Tom (Engineer): One suggestion for follow-up: if a probe consistently fails, surface a suggested fallback (e.g., try a different region) or an automated diagnostic run. Low priority.

Deploy Bot: deploy queued for branch ux/network-compact-rows by aisha  CI passed :white_check_mark:
_note: Messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names per agents.md
